tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the BAE Batteries USA website for stationary batteries, chargers and DC power: product pages, datasheets, discharge tables, manuals, SDS and technical articles. Ask in plain words, e.g. "12 V gel battery for solar" or "OPzS 2V cell SDS". Returns ids, titles and source links; read one with fet

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Read the full text of one result from search (a web page, a PDF, or a product series) with its link. A discharge table returns its figures once it has been checked against its datasheet, otherwise the link and page.

tools.name: find_series
tools.description: Find a stationary battery or product series that BAE Batteries USA offers by chemistry (VRLA gel, AGM, flooded, pure lead, lithium), nominal voltage (2 V, 6 V, 12 V, 48 V ...) or application (telecom, utility, solar, UPS, switchgear). Returns each series with its product page and documents.

tools.name: get_documents
tools.description: List the documents BAE Batteries USA publishes for a series, or of one type across the site: datasheet, discharge_table, manual, sds, certificate, standard, brochure, technical_paper, warranty. Third-party documents are linked at their source.

tools.name: quote_request
tools.description: How to ask BAE Batteries USA for a quote or price: the address to write to, and what to include so the engineers can answer without a round of questions. It sends nothing; the customer sends the request themselves.

tools.name: sizing_tool
tools.description: The link to the online tool BAE Batteries USA offers for sizing a battery system, and where the website links it. The customer runs it themselves; this connector cannot. A starting point only: engineers confirm every size before it is quoted.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
